note: PRISM M2 class masks: recipes only (Tier 0). class_masks.py turns each into an RGBA8 texture of 4 slot weights per base-map texel, built locally from the player's own extracted maps (Tier 2, never shipped). Order of sources (plan.md 4.1): P-auto (each UV island's dominant bone group -> class), T (colour tiebreak on the base map, inside non-plate texels), P-paint (polygons in normalised UV, v down, applied last). The live channel rule C (the shader's 'mask' in overlay.json) is applied on top in the renderer: slot A (index 0) is its class where the channel is above hi, and the mask's other slots share the rest. Bone groups are the skeleton's names without 'bip01 '/'frame ' and the 'l '/'r ' side. expect: the class fractions the gate holds the mask to, from island_stats/*.txt (CM 3.1), within tolerance_points.
